caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a carved figure of an owl sitting on a stylized base that resembles a log or branch. The owl is shown in a frontal view with its head turned slightly to the viewer's left. The body and head of the owl are rendered in shades of brown, with lined details for the feathers and large, round eyes with dark pupils. The beak is prominent and centrally located. The wings and tail feathers are intricately drawn with detailed patterning. The base is dark brown with lighter yellow-brown and reddish accents, giving it a wood-like texture and appearance. There is a round cut section visible on the left side of the base, showing tree rings in yellow and brown tones. The background of the drawing is plain and light beige, with a subtle circular shading behind the owl figure. The artist's signature “ED J. GISLEIDER” appears in the bottom right corner in faint gray lettering.
title: Mechanical Penny Bank: Owl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
